messages: Level up! Your hero grows a little stronger with every quest.
You've also earned a stat point to spend. visit the Heroes tab to assign it.
New gear! Anything you find sits in the stash until you equip it. check the Inventory tab.
Some contracts continue into a bigger story across several stages. these show up right on the Quest Board like any other.
Every hero slot is full. Recruiting costs gold, but the slots themselves come from Guild Hall upgrades or a Renown perk.
Raids are open. multi-hero expeditions with bigger rewards and longer odds. You'll need a full, exact-size party before sending one out.
A Black Market has opened up in Vendors. rarer stock than the regular shop, refreshed on its own rotation.
Legendary-tier contracts can now appear on the board -- the best rewards in the game, alongside the worst odds.
Heroic-difficulty raids are cleared for takeoff. harsher odds and longer expeditions, with loot to match.
Legendary raids are open. the hardest content in the game, and the only tier where the very best loot drops.

Blackford Keep is cleared, and the guild's first real siege makes the case for itself -- a Training tab has opened up. Fund it to start reassigning a hero's Melee/Ranged/Caster role from one dedicated spot.
A hero can now keep taking the next contract on their own for a while, instead of waiting for fresh orders each time -- toggle it from a hero's own Quest Tab entry.
The guild bard just learned a new song. pick it (or shuffle through everything you've earned) from the Track option in Settings.

A hurt hero or worn-down gear both drag down the odds on every quest, not just the one that caused it -- don't just wait it out. Treat an injury or Repair a piece of gear right from a hero's card in the Heroes tab (or spend a Field Bandage there instead of gold).

Each hero's very first Treat and first Repair are free, on the guild. everything after that costs gold. A Physician's Charity or Smith's Charity guild upgrade can make more of each free every day, for every hero.
A hero's Health just hit zero and they're Fallen -- benched until revived, no quests or raids for them until then.
Revive them for gold right from the Heroes tab, or wait out the Infirmary's free auto-revive timer once it's unlocked.
